facts.text: The hotel is on Charles Street in Mayfair, a brief walk from Bond Street, Hyde Park, the Royal Academy and Buckingham Palace.
facts.excerpt: our hotel on Mayfair's Charles Street offers a serene sanctuary amidst the bustling city life. With a prime central London location, just a brief walk from Bond Street, Hyde Park, and iconic landmarks such as The Royal Academy and Buckingham Palace

facts.text: The hotel is part of The Red Carnation Hotel Collection.
facts.excerpt: As a proud part of The Red Carnation Hotel Collection

facts.text: Guests enter through a marble lobby.
facts.excerpt: enter our polished marble lobby and immediately experience the warm and personal service

facts.text: Rooms and suites are individually designed, with moods ranging from bold and whimsical to exotic, elegant or cosy.
facts.excerpt: Our beautifully appointed and individually designed 94 deluxe guest rooms and 14 luxurious suites capture almost any mood that takes your fancy: bold, whimsical, exotic, elegant, or cosy.

facts.text: Bedroom fabrics reflect the pinstripes of nearby Savile Row, English cottage-garden florals or the vibrancy of the African savannah.
facts.excerpt: Within our bedrooms you'll find fine fabrics that reflect the pinstripes of nearby Savile Row, the florals of an English cottage garden, or the vibrancy of the African savannah.

facts.text: Rooms have Savoir beds and bespoke Chesterfield linen.
facts.excerpt:
- Luxury Savoir double bed
- Luxury toiletries
- Bespoke Chesterfield linen

facts.text: Interconnecting and interleading rooms can accommodate four to five people, depending on availability, and must be booked directly with the reservations team.
facts.excerpt: These rooms can accommodate four to five people, depending on availability, and must be booked directly through our reservations team.

facts.text: Stanley's is a rooftop bar above Mayfair named in honour of Stanley Tollman.
facts.excerpt: Stanley’s is a relaxed rooftop bar above Mayfair, created in honour of Stanley Tollman, whose lifelong passion for hospitality, cocktails, and delicious food inspired this space.

facts.text: Stanley's has a covered, heated rooftop with blankets and views across Mayfair.
facts.excerpt: our covered rooftop is heated, with cosy blankets on hand so you can settle in whatever the weather.

facts.text: Butlers Restaurant uses organic, seasonal British ingredients; its signature dish is Dover sole filleted at the table.
facts.excerpt: Butlers Restaurant offers delicious dishes that make the most of organic, seasonal British ingredients, such as our signature dover sole, filleted at your table.

facts.text: Sem's of Mayfair is the hotel bar, furnished in bottle green with deep club chairs and a long bar.
facts.excerpt: Sem's of Mayfair, elegantly furnished in bottle green, with deep club chairs and a long, stylish bar

facts.text: Sem's of Mayfair is named after the artist Georges Goursat, known as Sem, whose illustrations adorn the bar's walls.
facts.excerpt: The bar was named after the artist Georges Goursat; better known by his pen name, "Sem", whose playful illustrations adorn the bar's walls.

facts.text: Sem's of Mayfair has live music in the evenings, including a jazz quartet and a live singer and pianist.
facts.excerpt: As twilight descends, immerse yourself in the seductive rhythm of live musical performances, including a jazz quartet, and a live singer and pianist.

facts.text: The Sweetshop Afternoon Tea features smoking pink lemonade and sweetshop-themed cakes, served in the Conservatory or Butlers Restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a whimsical Original Sweetshop Afternoon Tea featuring theatrical smoking pink lemonade and surprising and delicious sweetshop-themed cakes, served in the airy brightness of the Conservatory or the elegant surrounds of Butlers Restaurant.

facts.text: The Sweetshop Afternoon Tea is designed for both adults and children.
facts.excerpt: where both adults and children can revel in nostalgic indulgence

facts.text: The Courtyard offers al fresco dining, open subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: Open subject to availability, The Courtyard is an oasis of tranquility and refinement in one of London’s most exclusive districts. Join us for al fresco dining and relaxation.

facts.text: Guests can design a bespoke seven-course menu with the Executive Chef, sourcing ingredients at Borough Market.
facts.excerpt: Design a bespoke seven-course menu with our Executive Chef, sourcing ingredients at Borough Market.

facts.text: The hotel offers a Hidden Wildlife of London Tour through the city's parks with an ecologist and nature guide.
facts.excerpt: This captivating tour with Connor Butler, Ecologist and Nature Guide, takes you on a journey through the city’s parks

facts.text: The hotel offers a women-led Mayfair art tour highlighting female artists and galleries.
facts.excerpt: Explore Mayfair's art scene on a women-led tour highlighting female artists, gallerys, and industry roles.

facts.text: A family bug-hunting session with an ecologist explores insects in London's green spaces.
facts.excerpt: Perfect for kids and adults alike, this session with Ecologist and Nature Guide Connor Butler offers a fun way to discover the fascinating world of insects

facts.text: The Chesterfield Suite has plush decor, luxurious furnishings and bespoke amenities.
facts.excerpt: Our Chesterfield Suite exudes timeless elegance with its plush decor and luxurious furnishings. Featuring bespoke amenities

facts.text: Shepherd Market, one of the oldest parts of Mayfair, is moments from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: One of the oldest parts of Mayfair, Shepherd Market is home to a variety of charming pubs, boutique shops, restaurants, and a cinema, just moments from The Chesterfield Mayfair.

facts.text: The Royal Academy of Arts is a leisurely stroll from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in the splendour of the Royal Academy of Arts Museum. Just a leisurely stroll away from The Chesterfield Mayfair

facts.text: The hotel spans three Georgian townhouses.
facts.excerpt: Spanning three Georgian townhouses, this Mayfair hotel

facts.text: Guests are greeted by a top-hatted doorman before a wood-paneled lobby with leather armchairs, antiques and chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: Expect to be greeted by a doorman sporting a top hat before walking into a wood-paneled lobby and sitting area accented with chunky leather armchairs, antiques, and chandeliers.

facts.text: Suite guests have canapes brought to them each evening.
facts.excerpt: Book a suite to have canapés bought to you each evening

facts.text: The Sweetshop Afternoon Tea won an Award of Excellence at the 2026 Afternoon Tea Awards.
facts.excerpt: We’re proud to share our recent prestigious award: ‘Award of Excellence’ at the 2026 Afternoon Tea Awards.

facts.text: In-room dining offers an all-day menu and a Night Menu overnight.
facts.excerpt: A Night Menu is available overnight for late arrivals or evening cravings.
